product.title: 6 Dual-Zipline Mountain Adventure in Maui

description.text: Enjoy unparalleled coastal views as you soar through jungle heights during this small-group zip lining excursion in Maui. Get hands-on assistance from your guide as you ride down six panoramic, sky-high lines. Stops include Kapalua Ziplines, Suspension Bridge, Dual Zipline Course. Tours include a fast-paced ATV ride deep into the rainforest and a trek over Hawaii's longest suspension bridge. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
